tools.name: get_tool_help
tools.description: Describe one tool visible on this facade, including its exact contract, or return a bounded workflow overview for one supported topic.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Choose data or geometry to list published pack IDs or family and scope IDs. The response includes a complete catalog download URL. Use get_pack for data or get_geography for geometry. Current catalog: The same geography tools work worldwide across a cataloged baseline of 252 geographic entities, rea

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: Inspect one exact data pack ID for its metrics, time coverage, and query metadata before get_data.

tools.name: get_geography
tools.description: Inspect one published geometry family across scopes or one scope across families. Returns coverage and known editions from catalog metadata only. Optional year selects the latest admitted edition no later than that year when the selected catalog has an edition index; an unavailable index is reported

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Retrieve one exact disaster event and explicitly requested relationships, affected places, native observations, or geometry. Use get_data to obtain the stable event_id first.

tools.name: resolve_point
tools.description: Resolve WGS84 coordinates in exactly one selected scope and family. Set scope_id=GLOBAL with family=administrative for Global Admin0, a published ISO3 with family=administrative for its shallow country bank, or scope_id=MARINE with family=marine_jurisdiction or water_body. Marine water_body also req

tools.name: resolve_deep_point
tools.description: Second-pass containment only after resolve_point. Supply the original WGS84 coordinate or a bounded point array, one shared shallow_loc_id returned by resolve_point, and one canonical family from get_catalog(catalog='geometry'). family defaults to administrative; shape-backed families use direct bbo

tools.name: get_loc_id_info
tools.description: Look up one known loc_id or a small batch in the selected reference graph. Return its identity and directly recorded loc_id connections, with family, direction, and relationship evidence. Each ID returns at most 50 connections and an explicit has_more flag. This tool does not expand descendants, inf

tools.name: identify_dataset_geography
tools.description: Fast structural column selector: pass bounded named columns to find recognized geography headers or latitude/longitude pairs. It does not infer a country, level, or identifier system, open country indexes, or validate values. If more than one column is plausible, select one; then call identify_refer

tools.name: identify_reference_system
tools.description: Identify one selected identifier column within one required ISO3 country, GLOBAL, or MARINE scope. Pass bounded strings preserving leading zeros. It checks maintained identifier evidence, not dataset columns or polygons. Ambiguous systems stay unselected until expected.system is supplied. Use identi

tools.name: convert_reference
tools.description: Convert within one declared scope per call: iso3 is required and names one ISO3 country, GLOBAL, or MARINE. A batch uses one from_system, to_system, and crosswalk_id, with at most 25000 requested result rows. Convert X -> loc_id -> Y; omit to_system to enter the loc_id universe. For admin or city na

tools.name: compare_geographies
tools.description: Compare two known loc_ids using selected reference-graph identity and direct relationship evidence. Verified Admin ancestry can prove containment; a typed graph edge can prove only the relation it declares. An explicit negative edge returns no_overlap; a missing edge returns unknown. This tool never

tools.name: get_shape
tools.description: Shape lookup for exact existing loc_ids only. The default returns shape availability, centroid, and bounding box; include_polygon=true adds GeoJSON coordinates. Obtain any descendant IDs before this call. Historical geometry is returned first and successors are never substituted automatically. Year

tools.name: get_data
tools.description: Retrieve rows from one selected published data pack using exact metrics, loc_id-based region filters, time/metric filters, sorting, and a row limit. Disaster event rows include stable event_id values for get_event drill-down. A parent administrative loc_id selects matching descendant rows at the pac

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_catalog · Public sink: resolve_deep_point.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_catalog · Public sink: resolve_deep_point

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
